name: spatial_growth_front
title: Spatial growth front
claim: Biomass seeded at the top edge of the COMETS field forms an advection-driven growth front: it propagates down the lattice (front position advances), its centroid migrates downstream, and its spatial spread grows as the population feeds and is transported through the field.

purpose.question: When biomass is seeded at one edge of a diffusing nutrient field, does it propagate across the lattice as an emergent spatial growth front?
purpose.mechanism: New biology-forward study (discovery engine): a new configuration/analysis of a real spatio-flux composite.
purpose.expected_outcome: The quantitative behavior tests pass, confirming the stated emergent/metabolic claim.

question: When biomass is seeded at one edge of a diffusing nutrient field, does it propagate across the lattice as an emergent spatial growth front?

behavior_tests.name: SPATIAL-GROWTH-FRONT-ADVANCES
behavior_tests.description: the biomass front (first row above threshold) advances down the lattice.

behavior_tests.name: SPATIAL-GROWTH-FRONT-CENTROID-MIGRATES
behavior_tests.description: the biomass centroid migrates downstream along y (directed plume).

behavior_tests.name: SPATIAL-GROWTH-FRONT-SPREAD-GROWS
behavior_tests.description: the biomass radius of gyration grows (spatial spread).

findings.statement: Biomass seeded at one edge forms an advancing growth front — front position advances, centroid migrates downstream, spread grows — as growing biomass is transported by the field's advection-diffusion. This spatial front is a behavior the well-mixed metabolism studies cannot exhibit (growth is coupled to spatial transport, not purely self-organized).

resolved: A biomass front propagates across the COMETS lattice under advection-diffusion.
remaining: The front velocity's dependence on the diffusion vs growth balance is unquantified.

followup_study_proposals.motivation: The front advances, but is its velocity (and whether the colony stays localized or disperses) set by the diffusion/growth ratio? Sweep diffusion_rate to map the regime boundary.

falsifiability: If the biomass front position and centroid did not advance from the seed edge despite biomass growth, the 'propagating growth front' claim would be false.
limitations: comets_diffusion carries an imposed advection field, so the front is advection-driven transport of growing biomass, not purely self-organized pattern formation; a no-advection control / Fisher-KPP velocity calibration is not included.
A single lattice, advection, and horizon.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: The advancing front is passive diffusion/advection of the seeded band, with no growth.
alternative_hypotheses.excluded_by: Total biomass grows many-fold over the run, so the front carries newly produced biomass, not merely transported seed.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: The front is self-organized pattern formation independent of the imposed flow.
alternative_hypotheses.excluded_by: NOT excluded — advection is imposed by the composite; the claim is limited to an advection-driven growth front (a no-advection control is the proposed follow-up).
